# Weigh Anchor

> AI and automation implementation for organizations that still run on paper forms, spreadsheets and manual handoffs, plus construction project management for public and private owners.

## About

Weigh Anchor LLC is a veteran-owned firm based in Snohomish, WA. It has two lines of work: AI and business automation implementation, and construction project management. It serves federal agencies, tribal nations and private sector organizations across 18 states and a U.S. territory.

Founded by a U.S. Air Force Civil Engineering veteran. SDVOSB certified.

## AI and Automation Implementation
- AI Implementation: Document processing, automated reporting and intelligent workflows deployed into operations
- Automation and Digitization: Converting paper forms, manual handoffs and spreadsheets into automated systems
- Process Mapping and Improvement: Documenting how work actually flows and identifying bottlenecks
- Ongoing Support and Training: Team training on every system built, with continued maintenance and evolution

## Construction Project Management
- Project Management: Full lifecycle oversight from procurement through closeout
- Project Controls: Budget tracking, schedule forecasting, change order management
- Program Management: Standardized reporting, resource allocation, risk management across portfolios
- Field Operations: Site inspections, quality assurance, contractor oversight

## Construction Copilot

Construction Copilot is a trade name (DBA) of Weigh Anchor LLC and its line of software products for construction.
- Website: https://www.constructioncopilot.com
- Daily Report: A daily report app for construction crews. Talk for a minute and get a signed PDF. Free for iPhone and Android, no account needed, works with no signal. https://www.constructioncopilot.com/
- Products: https://www.constructioncopilot.com/products

## Who We Serve
- Federal agencies (Department of Justice, Department of Veterans Affairs)
- Tribal nations (60+ across 16 states)
- Private sector organizations (Pfizer, construction firms, real estate companies)
- Small and mid-size businesses ready to modernize operations
